_notes: Formal park verdicts. Read this before touching ANY tool. Nothing parked is re-attempted without citing new information.

parked.root_cause: Docker image layering: PB task image has /workspace/executable as ELF binary. Compiled image has /usr/local/bin/igrep (6.8MB) + shell wrapper but no /workspace/executable. After PB wipes /workspace/, failing branches evaluate in task-image context where wrapper target path does not exist. TUI tests (tmux) pass; non-TUI tests fail with rc=127. Not fixable without PB harness change.
parked.new_info_required: PB harness change that preserves /workspace/executable across image layers, OR a way to install our binary directly at /workspace/executable path during compile.sh

parked.root_cause: Two structurally irreconcilable failures: (1) test_gap_fill_term x2: Fscanf blocks on PTY slave in test context; (2) test_http_source_ticker x2: needs -cover build flag but -cover flag (v3) broke Cluster A passing tests. Best achievable: 1438/1444.
parked.new_info_required: A way to enable -cover build for specific branches only, or a synthetic PTY harness that unblocks Fscanf test. Otherwise ceiling is 1438/1444.

Not a mechanical conversion.
